THE STUDIO

Independent.
Intentional.

Oddmash is a one-person independent software studio. Each project keeps its own identity, while sharing a commitment to practical solutions and thoughtful craft.

Start with a real problem.

Build the smallest useful thing, then improve it with evidence.

Care about the details.

Accessibility, reliability and readable interfaces matter.

Keep the work open.

Public projects make it possible to inspect, learn and contribute.

OPEN SOURCE

Make something better.

Found a problem or have a concrete improvement? Voluntary contributions to our public projects are welcome.
